description: For input index \(a\), approximation \(h\), set \(C\subseteq\mathbb N\), and \(q=2e+i\), \(i<2\), the candidate computes \(C\) exactly when \(\varphi_e^{A_i}(x)=\operatorname{some}(\chi_C(x))\) for every \(x\), using the specified constructed side \(A_i\). Equality requires termination.
